business_summary.text: Rossari Biotech Limited is a Specialty-Chemicals manufacturer providing intelligent and sustainable solutions for customers across industries, operating in Home, Personal Care and Performance Chemicals (HPPC), Textile Specialty Chemicals (TSC), and Animal Health and Nutrition (AHN) segments.

call_points.text: Management focused on driving optimal utilisation of new investments and strengthening product portfolio
Strategic capacity investments in place to support long-term value creation
Healthy momentum in domestic business and continued international expansion
Disciplined execution to maintain profitable growth despite higher costs
Healthy balance sheet position to support future growth initiatives
EBITDA margins for FY27 are guided to remain between 12% to 13%, with potential improvement in the second half from higher-margin segments.
CAPEX for FY27 is planned to be between ₹50 crore to ₹75 crore following a rephasing of earlier larger investments.

timeline.summary: Rossari Biotech Limited’s **Parul Gupta (Head - Company Secretary & Legal)** announced a Q4 FY26 earnings conference call for investors and analysts on **April 28, 2026, at 05:00 PM (IST)**.
Rescheduled capacity expansion project at subsidiaries Unitop Chemicals and Tristar Intermediates to a phased two-year timeline.
Rossari Biotech reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹2,396.37 Cr and PAT of ₹149.21 Cr, appointed Udeypaul Singh Gill as an independent director, and rescheduled its capex rollout.

Rossari Biotech reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹684.9 Cr (up 18% YoY) and PAT of ₹46.0 Cr (up 34%), with EBITDA margin at 11.3%, and said Unitop commissioned the remaining 15,000 MTPA ethoxylation capacity at Dahej on 31 March 2026.
Rossari Biotech reported Q4FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹684.9 Cr and announced rephased FY27 capex of ₹50-75 Cr.
Rossari Biotech's subsidiary Unitop Chemicals completed the sale of its Saki Naka office premises for ₹10.50 Cr.
Rossari Biotech approved the re-appointment of Esha Padmanabhan Achan as an independent director and granted 8,30,050 stock options at ₹537 each.
Sunil Srinivasan Chari (Promoter) declared no encumbrance or pledge on Rossari Biotech shares by Promoter Group for FY2025-26 under SEBI Regulation 31(4).
Rossari Biotech received a Section 34 arbitration petition from Unitop Chemicals sellers challenging the January 2026 arbitral award.
